name: pyRevit
knownFor: A free, scriptable toolbar for batch tasks, sheets, and custom firm tools.
popCaption: 90 firms listed pyRevit in Confluence 2025 — among the most-used Revit utilities in that survey · checked Nov 2026
learn: Gentler to start; steeper if you write your own tools
pro: Free, extensible, and already on many firm images
con: You still need someone who can maintain scripts and upgrades
costCaption: Free and open source; no license fee (github.com/pyrevitlabs/pyRevit, checked Nov 2026).

name: Avail
knownFor: Firm-wide content and family management so teams insert approved Revit content.
popCaption: 68 firms listed AVAIL in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Keeps office standards out of random desktop folders
con: Value depends on how carefully the library is curated
costCaption: Official plans: free single-user tier; paid AVAIL $250/year or $25/month (getavail.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Rated on the paid single-user plan.

name: DiRoots Tools (DiRootsOne)
knownFor: A popular pack of Revit utilities, including SheetLink for Excel round-trips.
popCaption: 63 firms listed DiRoots Tools in Confluence 2025 · mid-2024 App Store write-ups cited DiRootsOne at 5 stars with 54 reviews · checked Nov 2026
pro: Sheet and parameter tools that pay off on the first project
con: Licensing has been shifting toward freemium/paid tiers; confirm the current model
costCaption: Premium €100/user/year; US price $120/user/year via ATG USA. A free feature-limited tier exists (diroots.com/revit-plugins/dirootsone/, checked Nov 2026). Rated on Premium.

name: Ideate Software
knownFor: Excel/BIM data (BIMLink), model audit (Explorer), and view/sheet tools used by BIM managers.
popCaption: Confluence 2025 inventory: Ideate Explorer 51, BIMLink 50, Sticky 48, StyleManager 46, IdeateApps 44. The survey's Productivity category is described as dominated by Ideate and CTC · checked Nov 2026
pro: Serious data and model-health tools for standards-heavy offices
con: A paid suite; each product has its own learning curve
costCaption: IdeateApps official: $495/year standalone ($795 network). Automation starts at $2,495/year; Enterprise is quote (ideatesoftware.com/ideateapps-purchase, checked Nov 2026). Rated on the published IdeateApps standalone seat; a full-suite office costs more.

name: CTC Software (BIM suites)
knownFor: Long-standing production and BIM-management toolkits (Project, Manager, Batch, and Data suites).
popCaption: Confluence 2025: CTC BIM Manager Suite 42 firms, Project Suite 41, Batch Suite 35, Data Suite 25 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Batch and standards tools BIM managers have relied on for years
con: Published street pricing is limited; you usually talk to sales
costCaption: Official shop: BIM Project Suite $410; BIM Manager Suite $900; BIM Data Suite $2,200; BIM Batch Suite $290 (ctcsoftware.com/shop, checked Nov 2026). Rated on Project Suite, the common starting set.

name: RevitLookup
knownFor: A free API inspector that shows what Revit actually stores on an element.
popCaption: 50 firms listed RevitLookup in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
learn: Moderate — aimed at power users and developers
pro: The fastest way to understand parameters and element data
con: It is a diagnostic tool, not a production toolbar for every user
costCaption: Free and open source; no license fee (github.com/jeremytammik/RevitLookup, checked Nov 2026).

name: Bird Tools
knownFor: Batch Navisworks export, tag cleanup, and in-session clash prevention add-ins.
popCaption: Bird Tools Free NavisExport ranked #1 among APS-powered Revit add-ins on the Autodesk App Store as of 7 Feb 2025 (vendor recap of the official store sort). Not listed under this name in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Practical batch export and annotation tools, including a free NavisExport
con: Firm-survey evidence is thinner than for pyRevit, Ideate, or CTC
costCaption: Official shop: individual tools $10–$49.50/year (e.g. Tag Alignment $10, Clash Preventor $20, Raven $49.50). Several tools are free (birdtools-developers.com/shop.html, checked Nov 2026).

name: COINS Auto-Section Box
knownFor: A long-time favorite for quickly building and toggling 3D section boxes, including in links.
popCaption: 34 firms listed it in Confluence 2025. It was historically a top Autodesk App Store download (including a mid-2024 recap at 5 stars with 130 reviews). Autodesk forum posts in 2025-2026 report the App Store listing was later taken down — confirm a current official installer before installing · checked Nov 2026
pro: Still widely remembered as the fastest section-box workflow
con: Official distribution has been disrupted; do not grab unofficial copies
costCaption: Taken down from the Autodesk App Store; no current public price found. Editorial estimate $ · checked Nov 2026.

name: Bonus Tools (Kiwi Codes)
knownFor: A large collection of everyday Revit utilities sold as one add-in pack.
popCaption: Often named in 2026 best Revit add-ins roundups, but only 2 firms listed Kiwi Codes in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
pro: A lot of small time-savers in one installer
con: Survey evidence of firm-wide adoption is weak compared with Ideate or DiRoots
costCaption: No public shop price confirmed this session. A Kiwi Codes ROI calculator mentions $35/user/year, which was not treated as a purchase listing. Editorial estimate $ · checked Nov 2026.

name: UNIFI Pro
knownFor: An older generation of firm-wide Revit content management (the Confluence survey marks it as legacy).
popCaption: 15 firms listed UNIFI Pro (legacy) in Confluence 2025, versus 68 for AVAIL · checked Nov 2026
pro: Some offices still have libraries and workflows built around it
con: The 2025 survey already labels the listing as legacy — check the vendor's current product
costCaption: No public list price found on unifilabs.com this session; sold as a subscription quote. Editorial estimate $$ · checked Nov 2026.

name: Xrev Transmit
knownFor: Batch printing, PDF/DWF export, and transmittals from Revit.
pro: Saves hours on issue sets and plotting
con: No firm-penetration figure found in the Confluence 2025 inventory or a current App Store review count this session
costCaption: No current public price confirmed on xrev.com.au this session (an older listing of $35/year could not be re-checked). Editorial estimate $ · checked Nov 2026.

name: AGACAD
knownFor: Wood and metal framing, cut openings, and other construction-oriented Revit automation.
pro: Purpose-built framing and opening tools that generic Revit lacks
con: No independent 2025-2026 firm-survey count found this session
costCaption: No public list price found on agacad.com this session; tools are sold as a product family, often by quote. Editorial estimate $$ · checked Nov 2026.
